items.title: Timekettle Launches $129 LiveTalk Open-Ear AI Interpreter Earbuds
items.summary: Timekettle introduced the LiveTalk Open-Ear AI Interpreter Earbuds on October 8, 2026, priced at $129. The open-ear TWS model delivers real-time translation for everyday conversations across languages.

items.title: Samsung Unveils Galaxy Buds On, Its First Clip-On Open-Ear Earbuds
items.summary: Samsung revealed the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on open-ear wireless earbuds, arriving in South Korea on October 27. The buds feature Gemini Live voice control, head gestures, and up to 9.5 hours of playback.

items.title: Fairphone Fairbuds 2 Arrive October 14 with Seven Replaceable Parts
items.summary: Fairphone confirmed the Fairbuds 2 launch on October 14, 2026, keeping its modular repairable design with seven replaceable parts. The earbuds add LDAC codec support and cost 119 euros or dollars.

items.title: Omdia: TWS Shipments Dip 0.7% While Open-Ear Grows 12% in Q2 2026
items.summary: Omdia reports global true wireless stereo shipments fell 0.7% year over year to 82.1 million units in Q2 2026, the first decline since 2023. Open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1 million units, with clip-on designs leading at 61% of OWS.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Stunning Sound, a Half Step Behind Bose and Apple
items.summary: PCMag rates the Sony WF-1000XM6 at 4.0 Excellent, praising class-leading ANC, LDAC hi-res audio and strong call quality. Reviewers note a bulky fit and premium price versus the Bose QuietComfort Ultra and AirPods Pro 3.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open with Sound by Bose Open for Pre-Booking in India
items.summary: Noise opened pre-bookings for the Master Buds Open clip-on earbuds in India ahead of an October 23 launch at 7,999 rupees. The open-ear TWS pairs Sound by Bose tuning with a 10.8mm driver, 4-mic ENC and 28 hours of battery.

items.title: OPPO Enco X3s Debut Globally with 55dB ANC and LHDC 5.0
items.summary: OPPO launched the Enco X3s premium TWS earbuds globally alongside the Find X9 series. The buds offer dual drivers, Dynaudio tuning, 55dB adaptive ANC, LHDC 5.0 Hi-Res audio and up to 45 hours of total playback at 129 euros.

items.title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen Launch at $299 with Cinema Mode
items.summary: Bose launched the second-generation Ultra Open Earbuds on October 1, 2026, at $299. Upgrades include a redesigned driver, 9-hour battery, wireless charging case, Cinema Mode and AI SpeechClarity call noise reduction.

items.title: Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 Launches in India with Replaceable Batteries
items.summary: Sennheiser launched the Momentum True Wireless 5 in India at 29,990 rupees, with open sales from October 1. The earbuds feature user-replaceable batteries, TrueResponse drivers, aptX Lossless, Dolby Atmos and Bluetooth 6.0.

items.title: Shokz Highlights OpenDots 2 and OpenFit Air 2 in 2026 Open-Ear Lineup
items.summary: Shokz detailed its 2026 open-ear lineup including the new OpenDots 2 clip-on earbuds and featherlight OpenFit Air 2 hook earbuds. Both target all-day awareness listening with Bluetooth 6.1, multipoint and long battery life.
